proof_body:
by
  intro K V _ _ _ f
  constructor
  · intro h
    let S : Set V := {x | ∃ μ : K, f x = μ • x}
    have hS : Submodule.span K S = ⊤ := by
      rw [eq_top_iff, ← h]
      refine iSup_le fun μ x hx => Submodule.subset_span ⟨μ, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hsS, hspan, hli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent K S
    have htop : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span K (Set.range ((↑) : s → V)) := by
      rw [Subtype.range_coe, hspan, hS]
    have hmem : ∀ i : s, ∃ a : K, f (i : V) = a • (i : V) := fun i => hsS i.2
    choose a ha using hmem
    refine ⟨s, Module.Basis.mk hli htop, a, fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [Module.Basis.mk_apply]
    exact ha i
  · rintro ⟨s, b, a, h⟩
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← b.span_eq, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (le_iSup (fun μ : K => Module.End.eigenspace f μ) (a i)) (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (h i))
target_source: ∀ (K V : Type*) [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (f : Module.End K V), (⨆ μ : K, Module.End.eigenspace f μ) = ⊤ ↔ ∃ (s : Set V) (b : Module.Basis s K V) (a : s → K), ∀ i, f (b i) = a i • b i
